szenen.text: You said yes. So here it is: I read The Economist's 2027 cover as a risk map. Seven symbols. Here is what each one would mean.
1. An oil tanker in chains. Shipping lanes shut. Oil reprices first.
2. A broken pipeline. Energy gets expensive. Inflation comes back.
3. A falling chart next to casino chips. A market that turned into a casino, then the drop.
4. An hourglass beside the Kremlin. Time running out: a deal, or escalation.
5. A crescent and a star on red. It looks a lot like the Turkish flag: Turkey and the Gulf, after Iran.
6. A circuit brain, a robot, four men in suits. The AI trade, then the backlash.
7. Missiles, tanks, drones. More than one war still running.
This is just how I read the cover. Not a forecast. Which one worries you most? Comment the number.
